item.title: Could this week's snowfall cure Mt. Hood Meadows' winter woes?
item.description: Mt. Hood Meadows is receiving up to two feet of snow this week, providing a much-needed boost for the resort and local communities, and allowing for more terrain to be opened.

item.title: Wrong way driver arrested for DUI after crash into Lake Oswego police car
item.description: A wrong-way driver was arrested early Tuesday morning after crashing into a Lake Oswego police car, authorities announced.

item.title: Stabbing suspects arrested at Lincoln High School
item.description: Two suspects were arrested at Lincoln High School on Tuesday morning after a nearby stabbing, officials said.

item.title: Oregon group protests Portland Timbers over association with Bank of America
item.description: Third Act Oregon is protesting the Portland Timbers for using Bank of America as a sponsor, claiming the bank is using the team to "sportswash" its connections with big oil.

item.title: 7-year investigation ends with 5 facing prison for retail thefts worth $300K+
item.description: Five people are facing charges after a seven-year investigation into a retail theft fencing operation in Portland, which involved stealing hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of merchandise from stores such as Target and Fred Meyer and selling them online through a second-hand store called Card Rhino.
